class: a marker whose slug is not the entry's

expect.why: the marker names A0001-observation-held and the entry is A0001-observation-holds; a slug left behind by a rename names no entry, and is not resolved through the number it happens to share
the entry lists the note as citing it, and after the slug went stale the note cites nothing; the two directions disagree, which is the second half of the same defect

note: K36 is the near-negative: the same number, cited with no slug at all, which does resolve. The whole id is looked up first and only a marker carrying no slug falls back to the number, so admitting the short form does not cost this detection — a wrong slug is still a dangling citation and not a silent hit.
